svg.title: OPA microkernel architecture
svg.desc: Microkernel diagram for Open Policy Agent: stable core of Rego parser, compiler, topdown evaluator, and in-memory storage; plugin manager (plugins.Manager) defines Factory and Plugin interfaces; built-in and user plugins instantiated only when configured.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does OPA receive policy and data input?')
sendPrompt('What does the Rego parser do in OPA?')
sendPrompt('What does the Rego compiler do in OPA?')
sendPrompt('How does the topdown evaluation engine work in OPA?')
sendPrompt('What is OPA in-memory storage used for?')
sendPrompt('What does plugins.Manager do in OPA?')
g.text: Factory + Plugin interfaces: Validate · New · Start · Stop
Lifecycle mgmt · wires plugins to shared store + compiler · instantiates only configured plugins

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the OPA bundle plugin do?')

sendPrompt('What does the OPA decision log plugin do?')
sendPrompt('What does the OPA status plugin do?')
sendPrompt('How does runtime.RegisterPlugin let users add custom OPA plugins?')

svg.text: All plugins implement Factory + Plugin — Validate(cfg) · New(mgr, cfg) → Plugin · Start(ctx) · Stop(ctx)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does OPA return policy decisions?')
